0:
apk add --no-cache openssl >/dev/null
mkdir -p /data/tls
if [ ! -f /data/tls/privkey.pem ]; then
  openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 365 -newkey rsa:2048 \
    -keyout /data/tls/privkey.pem \
    -out /data/tls/fullchain.pem \
    -subj "/CN=mail.sa7mie.se"
  echo "Created bootstrap self-signed TLS cert in /data/tls"
fi
until nc -z xibo-mysql 3306; do echo waiting for mysql; sleep 2; done

setup:
  codecov_url: https://{{.Values.codecov.host }}
  codecov_api_url: https://{{.Values.codecov.host }}

  debug: no
  loglvl: INFO

  guest_access: off
  admins:
    - service: gitlab_enterprise
      username: Saphir
    - service: gitlab_enterprise
      username: Alexsaphir

  http:
    cookies_domain: {{.Values.codecov.host }}

  timeseries:
    enabled: false
  ta_timeseries:
    enabled: false

  telemetry:
    enabled: false

gitlab_enterprise:
  enabled: true
  url: https://gitlab.${DOMAIN_NAME}
  global_upload_token_enabled: false

  bot:
    username: Codecov

services:
  redis_url: redis://dragonfly.database.svc.cluster.local:6379/4
  minio:
    host: minio.minio-system.svc.cluster.local
    bucket: codecov
    region: us-east-1
    verify_ssl: false
    port: 9000

notifications:
  slack: off
  gitter: off
  webhook: off
  irc: off
  hipchat: off
